summary: Imperial Petroleum Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing covers revenues, net income, fleet updates, and a share repurchase program. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, rights offering, or forced management change is disclosed. The release is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. This is a normal periodic report on Form 6-K under the 1934 Act for a foreign private issuer.
